# Third-party notices

## Kadb

Luonnotar uses **Kadb** (`com.flyfishxu:kadb-android:1.3.0`) for direct local wireless ADB pairing and shell transport.
Kadb is Copyright its contributors and licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
Repository: https://github.com/flyfishxu/Kadb

Kadb's Android pairing runtime declares **SPAKE2-Java** (`com.github.Flyfish233:spake2-java:1.0.5`) as a runtime dependency.
SPAKE2-Java is licensed under GPL-3.0. Its license text is included as `GPL-3.0.txt`.
Repository: https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2-java

## Shizuku

The integrated-engine lifecycle and pairing UX were studied against the open-source Shizuku project.
No Shizuku icon, application ID, reserved permission, app name, or server code is redistributed as Luonnotar branding.
Shizuku remains an optional compatibility provider through its public API dependencies.
Shizuku is Copyright its contributors and its main project code is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
Repository: https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku

## Apache MINA SSHD

Luonnotar 2.6.0 uses **Apache MINA SSHD** (`org.apache.sshd:sshd-core:2.19.0`) to provide the shell-owned SSH rescue daemon. Apache MINA SSHD is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
Repository: https://github.com/apache/mina-sshd

## SLF4J

Luonnotar uses **SLF4J NOP** (`org.slf4j:slf4j-nop:2.0.18`) as the logging binding for the embedded SSH runtime. SLF4J is licensed under the MIT License.
Repository: https://github.com/qos-ch/slf4j
